title.rendered: Industrial-Grade Portable Office Cabins in Faridabad for On-Site Excellence

content.rendered:
Need an industrial-grade portable office cabin in Faridabad? SAMAN manufactures durable on-ground office cabins for factories and project teams across Ballabhgarh, Surajkund, Sector 16, Sector 21 and the NHPC Chowk industrial belt. Each unit is built new and delivered ready for the plant floor.

Why Faridabad businesses choose portable office cabins

Faridabad's factories and project locations need offices that can take dust, heat and constant use — and can move as work shifts across the plot.

  • Rugged IS 2062 steel frame built for industrial environments.
  • Quick to install and easy to relocate within the factory or site.
  • Insulated panels keep supervisor and technical cabins comfortable in summer.
  • Lower fixed cost than permanent construction.

Where portable office cabins work on Faridabad sites

  • Factory supervisor and production-floor cabins.
  • Project-management offices for infrastructure and development work.
  • Technical support and instrumentation cabins near the line.
  • Security and weighbridge cabins at plant gates.

What a SAMAN portable office cabin includes

Every cabin is built new to your floor plan at our own plant, so you control the size, the layout and the finish. Common footprints are 10×10 ft, 20×8 ft, 20×10 ft and 40×10 ft, used on their own or joined into multi-room layouts with private cabins, a meeting room and a washroom.

  • Structure: IS 2062 structural steel (MS) frame for strength and a long service life.
  • Walls and roof: insulated panels (around 50 mm) that keep the interior cooler in summer and cut outside noise.
  • Flooring: vitrified, ceramic or vinyl flooring chosen to suit the use.
  • Electricals: concealed wiring with switchboards, lighting, fan and air-conditioning points ready to connect.
  • Openings: powder-coated doors and windows, lockable, with optional grilles.
  • Add-ons: partitions, a pantry, a toilet, ramps, extra windows and custom branding in your colours.

Need a specific layout? Tell us how your team in Faridabad works and we design the cabin around it — a single workspace, a reception plus cabins, or a larger multi-room office.

Delivery and installation in Faridabad

Each cabin is manufactured at our Greater Noida plant (Jalpura, PIN 201308) and delivered to Faridabad ready to use. Typical transit is 3–5 days once the unit is ready, and default delivery is ₹3,000 where applicable.

A single cabin is craned into place in a few hours and a multi-cabin layout is assembled on the spot. Tell us about access at your Faridabad location — gate width, room for a crane and the ground condition — and we plan the placement before dispatch so installation day is straightforward.

Factory-direct, not a reseller listing

Many Faridabad buyers start on directory and listing sites, where one enquiry is shared with several traders and the actual maker is hard to identify. With SAMAN you deal directly with the manufacturer: one point of contact, factory-direct pricing with no middle margin, a written specification, and a single team responsible for the build, delivery and after-sales support. Because we control the steel frame and the fit-out, we can tell you exactly what goes into your cabin.

What a portable office cabin costs in Faridabad

There is no single fixed price — the cost depends on the size, the number of rooms, insulation, flooring, electricals and air-conditioning, the exterior finish and your site access.

A basic single-room cabin costs less than a fully fitted, air-conditioned multi-room layout with premium flooring and branding. Because you buy directly from the manufacturer there is no dealer margin, and we return a written, itemised quote against your exact requirement so you can see what each part adds. We do not quote a price blind — share your plan and you get real numbers.

Why buy direct from SAMAN, the manufacturer

SAMAN POS India Private Limited builds these units in-house, so a Faridabad buyer deals with the maker rather than a reseller. We are an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer, and each cabin carries a clear warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life (the service life is an engineering estimate, not a warranty). Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation. You can see the full range, sizes and specifications on our portable office cabin range.

Why Buy Your Portable Office Cabin Factory-Direct from SAMAN

Faridabad’s NIT sectors, Ballabgarh and the Mathura Road industrial areas (around PIN 121001) generate steady demand for site offices, security cabins and storage units. SAMAN manufactures portable office cabins in-house on an IS 2062 steel frame at its Bangalore (Gopasandra 560099) and Greater Noida (201308) units, with 500+ projects delivered. Each office cabin is built to your size with insulated wall and roof panels, vinyl or laminate flooring, doors, windows and electrical points. Delivery is Rs 3,000 with 3–5 day transit. Warranty is 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. Call or WhatsApp +91 88616 22859, or send an enquiry, for a size-matched quote. Browse the full portable office range or our portable office cabin page.

NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207, DPIIT recognised startup Ref. DIPP56005, Udyam registered UDYAM-KR-03-0172770, GST 29ABBCS7101B1ZR Bangalore and 09ABBCS7101B1ZT Noida.

FAQs: portable office cabins in Faridabad


How quickly can you deliver a portable office cabin to a Faridabad site?

Each cabin is built new at our Greater Noida plant (Jalpura, PIN 201308). Typical transit is 3–5 days once the unit is ready, and default delivery is ₹3,000 where applicable. A single cabin is craned into place in a few hours.


Can the cabins withstand Faridabad's extreme summer temperatures?

Yes — insulated wall and roof panels with provision for air-conditioning keep interiors workable through the summer.


What site preparation is needed?

A level, compacted surface is usually enough; for soft ground we advise a simple plinth or foundation. We confirm requirements before delivery.


What sizes are available?

Common sizes are 10×10 ft, 20×8 ft, 20×10 ft and 40×10 ft, used singly or joined into multi-room layouts with cabins, a meeting room and a washroom. We build to your floor plan.


What build quality and warranty do I get?

Each office uses an IS 2062 steel frame with insulated panels. The warranty is 5 years on the structural frame and base plus 1–2 years on finishing, and the engineered service life is 20–25 years (a service life, not a warranty).


Get a portable office cabin quote in Faridabad

Share your size, layout and site details and we will send a written quote with lead time for Faridabad — no obligation.

Call +91 88616 22859 or use our Send Enquiry form, and our team will help you choose the right cabin.
